top_signals.title: Iran Ramps Up Ship Attacks in Hormuz as Oil and Gas Flows Climb
top_signals.summary: Iran has increased the pace of attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz in recent days, just as oil shipments through the world’s most important energy chokepoint approach prewar levels.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Cinco razones por las que el petróleo sigue cerca de los US$100
top_signals.summary: El petróleo de Medio Oriente vuelve a fluir casi como antes de la guerra en Irán. Entonces, ¿por qué el crudo sigue sobre los US$100 por barril y un 40% por encima de los niveles previos al conflicto? Te explicamos cinco razones. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Ares Faces 50% Loss on Cash Piled Into TalkTalk With BT Deal
top_signals.summary: Ares Management Corp is set to lose about half of the hundreds of millions of pounds it invested in TalkTalk, after BT Group Plc agreed to buy the telecommunications firm out of insolvency.

top_signals.title: Cosan Rethinks Asset Sales After Debt Cut, Bolsonaro-Led Rally
top_signals.summary: Brazil conglomerate Cosan SA is reassessing plans to sell assets after it cut debt by half in the past year and as market conditions improved in Brazil on bets that opposition candidate Flávio Bolsonaro will be elected president, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Francis Halzen wins 2026 Nobel Prize in physics
top_signals.summary: Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr.
